name: shipment items
script:
source = frappe.form_dict.get("source")
reference = frappe.form_dict.get("reference")

if not source or not reference:
    frappe.throw("Source and Reference are required")

items = []

# ==========================================================
# DELIVERY NOTE
# ==========================================================

if source == "Delivery Note":

    dn = frappe.get_doc("Delivery Note", reference)

    for d in dn.items:

        used_qty = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sb.qty),0)
            FROM `tabShipment Box` sb
            INNER JOIN `tabShipment` s ON s.name = sb.parent
            WHERE
                s.docstatus = 1
                AND sb.delivery_note = %s
                AND sb.item_code = %s
        """,(reference,d.item_code))[0][0] or 0

        remaining_qty = d.qty - used_qty

        if remaining_qty <= 0:
            continue

        items.append({
            "item_code": d.item_code,
            "item_name": d.item_name,
            "description": d.description,
            "qty": remaining_qty,
            "uom": d.uom
        })


# ==========================================================
# PURCHASE ORDER
# ==========================================================

if source == "Purchase Order":

    po = frappe.get_doc("Purchase Order", reference)

    for d in po.items:

        used_qty = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sb.qty),0)
            FROM `tabShipment Box` sb
            INNER JOIN `tabShipment` s ON s.name = sb.parent
            WHERE
                s.docstatus = 1
                AND sb.purchase_order = %s
                AND sb.item_code = %s
        """,(reference,d.item_code))[0][0] or 0

        remaining_qty = d.qty - used_qty

        if remaining_qty <= 0:
            continue

        items.append({
            "item_code": d.item_code,
            "item_name": d.item_name,
            "description": d.description,
            "qty": remaining_qty,
            "uom": d.uom
        })


if not items:
    frappe.throw("All items already used in Shipment")

frappe.response["message"] = items
